Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the directors’ death dates, concluding that because 2008 > 1961, Stig Olin died first. This reverses the chronological order; George Melford (1961) died before Stig Olin (2008), so the correct film is Rocking Moon.
